```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

This notebook contains the instructions to assemble the receptor-ligand pair analysis dataset as illustrated by the workflow chart below. 
```{r echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics("./resources/images/pipeline_schematic.png")
```

#### Notebook outline:
1. Define the receptor-ligand pairs that form the same pairs between the orthologs between human and mouse.
   * Datasets: 1) mouse receptor-ligand pair data; 2) mouse-Acomys one-to-one orthologs; 3) human-mouse one-to-one orthologs; 4) human receptor-ligand pairs.
   * Filter for pairs where both the receptor and ligand have a defined mouse-Acomys and mouse-human ortholog. 
   * Filter for mouse receptor-ligand pairs that are the same between the orthologs of human and mouse.

2. Receptor expression in human iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes.
   * Apply a filter to the normalized RNA-seq counts of cultured cardiomyocytes. 

3. Cellular localization.
   * Datasets: 1) mouse secreted protein database annotation; 2) human plasma membrane protein database annotation; 3) DeepLock 2.0 prediction output (done beforehand).
   * Filter for pairs where the receptor human ortholog is annotated as a membrane protein and the ligand is annotated as a mouse secreted protein. 
   * Load the DeepLock 2.0 results for mouse and Acomys, map the one-to-one orthologs and filter for "extracellular" predictions that match between the orthologs.
   * Filter the receptor-ligand pairs again with the predicted secreted ligands.
4. Add the DESeq2 data.
   * Target condition DE results: in vitro FB plastic and Tomo-seq post-MI day 14 scar slices (16-24).
   * Control condition DE results: in vitro FB 8kPa and Tomo-seq sham.
5. Filter for pairs where the ligand expression direction is the same between the FB plastic and Tomo-seq scar results.

#### Input datasets
```{r}
# Receptor-ligand pairs
mus_rl_pairs <- readRDS("datasets/receptor-ligand_pairs/Mouse_receptor-ligand_pairs_Dimitrov-CellTalkDB.RData")
human_rl_pairs <- readRDS("datasets/receptor-ligand_pairs/Human_receptor-ligand_pairs_CellTalkDB.RData")

# Gene orthologs
mus_acomys_orthologs <- readRDS("datasets/gene_orthologs/Mus-Acomys_OrthoFinder_1to1_orthologs_wSymbols.RData")
mus_human_orthologs <- readRDS("datasets/gene_orthologs/Mus-human_biomaRt_1to1_orthologs.RData")

# Cellular localization
mus_secreted_annotated <- readRDS("datasets/cellular_localization/database_annotated/Mouse_annotated_extracellular_GO-SEPDB.RData")
human_membrane_annotated <- readRDS("datasets/cellular_localization/database_annotated/Human_annotated_plasmamembrane_GO.RData")
# DeepLoc prediction files are loaded and processed in the next block

# Normalized counts
human_cm_counts <- readRDS("datasets/normalized_counts/invitro_cell_culture_counts/hIPSC-CM_Ctrl_norm_counts.RData") %>%
  as.data.frame()

# DE analysis results
de_dir <- "datasets/differential_expression_analysis/"
deseq2_fb_8kpa_path <- paste0(de_dir, "DESeq2_invitroFB_MMvAC/DESeq2_output_invitroFB_8kPa_MMvAC.tsv")
deseq2_fb_plastic_path <- paste0(de_dir, "DESeq2_invitroFB_MMvAC/DESeq2_output_invitroFB_plastic_MMvAC.tsv")
deseq2_tomoseq_sham_path <- paste0(de_dir, "DESeq2_Tomoseq_MMvAC/DESeq2_output_Tomoseq_sham_MMvAC.tsv")
deseq2_tomoseq_scar_path <- paste0(de_dir, "DESeq2_Tomoseq_MMvAC/DESeq2_output_Tomoseq_fibrotic_MMvAC.tsv")
```

#### Preprocessing

Process the raw DeepLoc output for matching extracellular localization prediction between the species. Note: the "Protein ID" column in the output really contains Ensembl gene IDs. The proteome FASTA header lines were modified to contain gene IDs before supplying them to prediction. 
```{r}
# Function for loading DeepLoc output
load_deeploc_output <- function(file_path_list) {
  loaded_data <- file_path_list %>%
    map_df(~read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
    select(Protein_ID, Localizations) %>%
    filter(str_detect(Localizations, "Extracellular"))
}

# List the raw DeepLoc output files for both species
mus_deeploc_raw_files <- list.files(path = "datasets/cellular_localization/DeepLoc_output/raw_MM/", full.names = TRUE)
acomys_deeploc_raw_files <- list.files(path = "datasets/cellular_localization/DeepLoc_output/raw_AC/", full.names = TRUE)

# Load the DeepLoc output for both species
mus_deeploc_output <- load_deeploc_output(mus_deeploc_raw_files) %>%
  rename(Localization_MM = Localizations)

acomys_deeploc_output <- load_deeploc_output(acomys_deeploc_raw_files) %>%
  # Map one-to-one orthologs with Mus
  inner_join(mus_acomys_orthologs, by = c("Protein_ID" = "Acomys_EnsID")) %>%
  select(-Protein_ID) %>%
  rename(
    Localization_AC = Localizations,
    Protein_ID = Mus_EnsID
    )

# Combine the prediction results
deeploc_output <- inner_join(mus_deeploc_output, acomys_deeploc_output, by = "Protein_ID") %>%
  rename(Mus_ligand_EnsID = Protein_ID) %>%
  mutate(DeepLoc_MM_AC = "Extracellular") %>%
  select(-starts_with("Localization"))
```

Process the human-mouse orthologs. Remove the orthology type column if all orthologs are one-to-one, and rename the columns for common naming across all datasets. 
```{r}
mus_human_orthologs <- mus_human_orthologs %>%
  rename(
    Mus_EnsID = Mouse_Ensembl_gene_id,
    Human_EnsID = Human_Ensembl_gene_id
  )

if (unique(mus_human_orthologs$Mouse.homology.type)=="ortholog_one2one") {
  mus_human_orthologs <- mus_human_orthologs %>%
    select(-Mouse.homology.type)
} else {
  stop(paste("Multiple orthology types detected for mouse and human:", unique(mus_human_orthologs$Mouse.homology.type)))
}
```


#### 1. Define the receptor-ligand pairs that form the same pairs between the orthologs between human and mouse
```{r}
# Filter for mouse receptor-ligand pairs that have a one-to-one ortholog with Acomys
mus_rl_pairs <- mus_rl_pairs %>%
  filter(Mus_ligand_EnsID %in% mus_acomys_orthologs$Mus_EnsID,
         Mus_receptor_EnsID %in% mus_acomys_orthologs$Mus_EnsID)

## Add the mouse-human orthologs to the mouse receptor-ligand pair data
mus_rl_pairs <- mus_rl_pairs %>%
  # Ligands
  inner_join(., mus_human_orthologs, by = c("Mus_ligand_EnsID" = "Mus_EnsID")) %>%
  rename(Hum_ligand_EnsID = Human_EnsID) %>%
  # Receptors
  inner_join(., mus_human_orthologs, by = c("Mus_receptor_EnsID" = "Mus_EnsID")) %>%
  rename(Hum_receptor_EnsID = Human_EnsID)

human_rl_pairs <- human_rl_pairs %>%
  # Ligands
  inner_join(., mus_human_orthologs, by = c("Hum_ligand_EnsID" = "Human_EnsID")) %>%
  rename(Mus_ligand_EnsID = Mus_EnsID) %>%
  # Receptors
  inner_join(., mus_human_orthologs, by = c("Hum_receptor_EnsID" = "Human_EnsID")) %>%
  rename(Mus_receptor_EnsID = Mus_EnsID)

combined_rl_pairs <- inner_join(mus_rl_pairs, human_rl_pairs)
```
#### 2. Receptor expression in the human cardiomyocytes
```{r}
human_cm_counts <- human_cm_counts %>%
  rownames_to_column("Hum_receptor_EnsID") %>%
  filter(Hum_receptor_EnsID %in% combined_rl_pairs$Hum_receptor_EnsID) %>%
  mutate(Hum_receptor_avg_count = rowMeans(across(starts_with("Diff"))),
         Hum_receptor_avg_count = round(Hum_receptor_avg_count, 2)) %>%
  select(-starts_with("Diff")) %>%
  filter(Hum_receptor_avg_count >= 10)

analysis_dataset_1 <- combined_rl_pairs %>%
  inner_join(., human_cm_counts, by = "Hum_receptor_EnsID")
```

#### 3. Cellular localization
```{r}
# Ligand mouse extracellular annotation
analysis_dataset_1 <- analysis_dataset_1 %>%
  inner_join(., mus_secreted_annotated, by = c("Mus_ligand_EnsID" = "Ensembl_gene_id")) %>%
  select(-Gene_Name) %>%
  rename(Mus_ligand_loc_annotation = Subcellularlocation)

# Receptor human membrane annotation
analysis_dataset_1 <- analysis_dataset_1 %>%
  inner_join(., human_membrane_annotated, by = c("Hum_receptor_EnsID" = "GeneID")) %>%
  rename(Hum_receptor_loc_annotation = GO.NAME)

# Ligand extracellular DeepLoc prediction
analysis_dataset_1 <- analysis_dataset_1 %>%
  inner_join(., deeploc_output, by = "Mus_ligand_EnsID") %>%
  select(-Gene_symbol)
```

##### Load in the DE results
```{r}
# Function to load the DESeq2 data
load_deseq2_results <- function(file_path) {
  data <- read.delim(file_path)
  data_processed <- data %>%
    select(log2FoldChange, padj) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Mus_ligand_EnsID") %>%
    mutate(
      padj = -log10(padj),
      # Round to 2 decimals and cap at 50
      padj = round(pmin(padj, 50), 2),
      log2FoldChange = round(log2FoldChange, 2)
      ) %>%
    filter(padj >= 1.3) %>%
    select(-padj)
  
  return(data_processed)
}

deseq2_fb_8kpa <- load_deseq2_results(deseq2_fb_8kpa_path) %>%
  rename(
    ligand_FB_8kpa_log2FC = log2FoldChange
    )

deseq2_fb_plastic <- load_deseq2_results(deseq2_fb_plastic_path) %>%
  rename(
    ligand_FB_plastic_log2FC = log2FoldChange
    )

deseq2_tomoseq_sham <- load_deseq2_results(deseq2_tomoseq_sham_path) %>%
  rename(
    ligand_tomoseq_sham_log2FC = log2FoldChange
    )

deseq2_tomoseq_scar <- load_deseq2_results(deseq2_tomoseq_scar_path) %>%
  rename(
    ligand_tomoseq_scar_log2FC = log2FoldChange
    )
```

#### 4. Add the DESeq2 data
Join the DE results with the analysis dataset. The experimental condition DE results (FB plastic, Tomo-seq scar) will be joined in a way that only retains entries present in all sides (using `inner_join()`). The control condition DE results (FB 8kPa, Tomo-seq sham) are joined with `left_join()` to not discard ligands that are not DE in the control condition. The control DE results are included to get info on how the ligands are expressed in homeostatic conditions. 
```{r}
analysis_dataset_2 <- analysis_dataset_1 %>%
  
  # Add the experimental condition DE results
  inner_join(., deseq2_fb_plastic, by = join_by(Mus_ligand_EnsID)) %>%
  inner_join(., deseq2_tomoseq_scar, by = join_by(Mus_ligand_EnsID)) %>%
  
  # Add the control DE results
  left_join(., deseq2_fb_8kpa, by = join_by(Mus_ligand_EnsID)) %>%
  left_join(., deseq2_tomoseq_sham, by = join_by(Mus_ligand_EnsID))
```

For visualization purpose, save the dataset before applying the change direction and magnitude filters (to show all ligands on the plot).
```{r}
saveRDS(analysis_dataset_2, "pre-direction-filter_analysis_dataset.RData")
```

#### 5. DE magnitude and direction filters
Apply change magnitude filter (log2FC threshold) and leave only results where the change direction matches in the experimental condition samples (FB plastic and Tomo-seq scar).
```{r}
analysis_dataset_2 <- analysis_dataset_2 %>%
  filter(
    # lfc direction
    sign(ligand_tomoseq_scar_log2FC) == sign(ligand_FB_plastic_log2FC),
    # lfc threshold
    abs(ligand_tomoseq_scar_log2FC) >= 0.4, abs(ligand_FB_plastic_log2FC) >= 0.4
    )
```

Save the final analysis dataset
```{r}
saveRDS(analysis_dataset_2, "FB_secretome_analysis_dataset.RData")
```
